text:
The BEST English-speaking vet in Chiang Mai! 10/10 experience with my stray jungle pup- diagnosing with bloodwork/ultrasound, treating her for acute parasite infection, then getting her ready to fly the the United States. So glad I found this clinic to microchip, vaccinate, draw a rabies titer, fill CDC paperwork, etc because it was less than half the price quoted on pet travel guide websites, no agent needed.
My timeline was very tight- 60 days (would recommend starting much earlier than this!) but they were still able to accommodate me to travel to the US with the pup. Bonus tip- We flew on STARLUX airlines and had a great experience with them as well, enjoyed their $400 flat rate for dogs to fly.

Cannot recommend this clinic highly enough!! You will not be disappointed

text:
We recently visited Family Pet Clinic for Honey's annual vaccination. This was our second time at the clinic since moving to Chiang Mai, and the experience was once again fantastic.

Honey is a cat who is easily stressed and can get angry at the vet, but the team at Vat Clinic handled her perfectly. She was surprisingly calm and humble, showing no signs of the strong emotions she usually displays. This is completely thanks to the doctor and nurses, who are incredibly patient, gentle, and understanding.

It truly seems like Honey can sense their kindness and good intentions. I am so grateful to have found a clinic I can trust completely with my sensitive girl. Highly recommended

The vets are super professional and calm. My dog usually hates the vets but here she was calm and let the vets do their thing with zero complaint. The price is very affordable too! The vets speak really good English, too.
My baby Shinji loves this clinic and they treat him so well. 10/10!

I wanted to add to my previous 5 star review, and if I could give more stars I would.
The doctors here are really fantastic, knowledgeable and really care about their patients. I take my two dogs here frequently and they're treated with the best care.
My little pug had a rather complex facial and forelimb surgery, and being a bracycephalatic breed there were additional risks involved with anesthesia, but everything went very well including the post surgery care. Her follow up treatments and appointments have been informative and the doctor is suggestive of caution to care for her well-being instead of opting for expensive treatments or surgeries which could be detrimental for her.
I highly recommend the doctors and nurses at this clinic, thankyou for being our go to in Chiang Mai 💚

I highly recommend Family Pet Clinic. They have taken such good care of my cats during surgeries and also general checkups. The team is extremely professional and I always feel our cats are in good hands. The vets are very thorough with checkups and assessments and provide excellent bedside manner. The clinic is also very well equipped to conduct different kinds of services. For example, they have microchip services and help people prepare their pets for international travel, which is not often found in other clinics. We had both our cats successfully undergo dental scaling with Dr. New and they did a fantastic job. I’m excited about the clinic’s expansion and can’t wait to see the new services offered. Thank you again to the Family Pet Clinic team for taking amazing care of our cats! 🫶😻🙌
Dr New is fantastic as are his staff. He did dental surgery on my 14 year old dog and it was very successful and thorough. I will come back here for sure! Highly highly recommend!

Great service and good price. My cat has been suffering bad breath and gingivitis for long time. Whole mouth teeth cleaning and extraction have been done to my cat. Vet take care of my cat carefully. Very satisfied with their service.
We feel people here work with very good heart to help our dog. Friendly staffs and they took care the dog good during his stay. the room and cage are clean.
Family pet hospital provides the best care I’ve found in the area. The staff is professional, the facility is spotless, and they treated my pet like family.

Every time I visit this vet, I walk out with a bill close to 2,000 baht. Last time I was charged 1,000 baht for antibiotics and shampoo, with no itemised receipt. They also tried charging me 600 baht for a basic recovery collar — the kind dogs wear when they’re sick — which costs 50 baht at the local pet shop.

Today I called ahead and was told vaccinations would be 300–400 baht per dog. After spending 300 baht on taxis, I was quoted 700+ baht per dog at the clinic, with vague answers about “it depends what they use.”

How do you not know what you’re using or how much it costs when you vaccinate dogs every day?

Feels like they make up the prices as they go. No transparency. No breakdown of costs. Other vets charge half. This place overcharges and doesn’t explain what you're paying for.
Great service and best price for an RNATT test in Chiang Mai 🙏 …

First visit yesterday, after trying 3-4 other vets. Pleaseantly surprised. No 'yes yes' and nodding. If he don't know he says that, if there are various factors and/or treatments etc you can get an explanation and your questions answered (not easy to find coming from a westerns mindset..).
We got a good treatment and the price is fair. Nothing special compared to others in the same area. I'm looking forward to seeing how my dog will react to the help from here. Based on the consultation and experience I'm optimistic about it. Thanks guys and see you again for the follow up.
Btw. I'm better in English than in Thai, and the doctor was easily able to have a consultation in English, no worries there.
Very good animal care and customer service, experienced on our two visits with our dogs so far. These guys are our new vets of choice in Chiang Mai.

I tried to get treatment for a rescue puppy with severe mange and secondary infections and was treated quite rudely by staff who were reluctant to treat and were charging excessive fees for tests. It sounds like they are fine if you come in with a domestic pet but hostile to helping with rescues, which is very sad.

They take good care of my two peers.   One was sick with stomach virus which they prescribed medication for and the other has hard to find medication.   They did well with both pups.  As a bonus they speak English

Good English speaking vet, which was very attentive, knowledgeable and friendly. Inexpensive service and no wait time. The clinic itself looks new, clean and modern. I had routine vaccination for my cat.

Very clean vet clinic with kind staff and knowledgeable vet. Very professional and caring. Great prices too. The vet gave my cat a microchip and my cat was the calmest I have ever seen her at a vet clinic. Great atmosphere!
These people are so kind for your pet and they are so good at it

The one of the best veterinary here.
They safed my cat life. I will always recommend them to anyone 🙏 …
Very friendly vet that takes good care of your pets. They are very reasonably priced compared to other vets for the quality service they provide.
We visit this clinic regularly with our cats. They are well organised, friendly, and professional. Two of the doctors speak English.
Our cat needed an emergency checkup after getting in a fight.  This clinic was amazing and fit us in right away.
Terrific clinic. Bring my dog and cat here. English speaking, efficient and cost effective service.
Great neighborhood vet and a surgeon on staff who does amazing work.
I just got back home and am amazed how professional this clinic is. Thank you so much for all the help we needed!
Clean and up to standard facility. The service prices are not the cheapest but you will receive professional treatments here.

I brought Daisy (a senior Beagle) in for treatment of a broken leg. The veterinarian and veterinary team provided excellent care. They gave clear details about the care and treatment plan, offering various options to choose from. They have complete equipment to handle any case, and the hospital is very clean.
The vet is kind, the reception staff are friendly, and there's free drinking water for both pets and adults. The admin is a bit confused at times. Credit cards are accepted.
I came here to get my dog's paperwork done for traveling abroad. The clinic is clean, and all the doctors are kind and speak politely.

text: Excellent service and skilled doctors. All of my pets are treated at this clinic.

Not recommended.

Initially, things were good. The vet seemed to love all the dogs. But after using their services for a while, it wasn't so good.
- My dog ​​had an ear infection. After it improved slightly, they didn't follow up. When I went for another checkup, I found that my dog ​​was far from fully recovered.
- I left my dog ​​with them for boarding and bathing. When I picked her up, I was shocked. Her fur was matted all over (I had been getting her bathed there regularly at that time). When I asked the staff if they had really bathed her, they took her for a short time and then sent her back saying she had, but needed to be taken elsewhere for a shave. I never went back there for bathing again.
- The staff were clueless and didn't communicate well with each other. They took my dog ​​for a health checkup, dropped her off, and said they would call when she was finished, but they didn't. When I called, they said she was ready to pick her up, but I had to wait for a long time afterward.
- My dog ​​received her first vaccination around New Year's. When it was time for the next vaccination, they sent a message saying it was time, but there was an additional charge for service during the New Year period. They expected the customer to ask if we could just reschedule to a regular time.
- My dog ​​had a follow-up on her health checkup results. The clinic informed us one day beforehand, which wasn't convenient for us. When we tried to change the time, they asked what day was convenient for us. So we asked... "So, which day is the doctor who's handling my child's case available?" They even asked me back, "Do you want to see the same doctor?" I'm so frustrated. The staff are so inattentive.
- They made an appointment with a specific time frame, but made us wait for over half an hour with no updates and no one even bothering to ask.
Family Pet Clinic provides excellent service. The doctor is very kind. I've even made Dr. New my pet's regular vet.

I was very impressed. The doctor was kind, attentive, and explained everything in detail in an easy-to-understand way. The staff provided excellent service, the clinic was clean, and my pet wasn't stressed at all. Highly recommend this place for animal lovers 🐾 …
